react-hooks/config: Validates the React Compiler options passed to the rule. Both configs enable it with no options, so there is no compiler configuration for it to reject from any source file.
react-hooks/gating: Validates the React Compiler `gating` option passed to the rule. Both configs enable it without that option, so no source file can make it report.
unicorn/no-shorthand-property-overrides: A CSS rule (`meta.languages: ['css/css']`, needs `@eslint/css`). Neither config lints CSS files, so ESLint never runs it on the JavaScript and TypeScript files it is enabled for.
unicorn/no-transition-all: A CSS rule (`meta.languages: ['css/css']`, needs `@eslint/css`). Neither config lints CSS files, so ESLint never runs it on the JavaScript and TypeScript files it is enabled for.
